item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Premium luxury scented candle product photography, photorealistic editorial still life. One elegant smoked amber glass candle vessel with creamy ivory wax and a small gently burning flame, thick glass base, perfectly centered on a warm ivory travertine pedestal. Understated cream paper label with refined crisp typography reading 'EMBER' and smaller 'SANTAL & AMBER'. Brushed brass candle lid resting beside the vessel. Minimal warm beige studio background, subtle architectural shadows, soft directional window lighting from the left, delicate golden rim light, rich natural material textures, luxurious restrained styling, a single small sandalwood piece beside the base. Close three-quarter camera angle, beautiful precise glass reflections, tack-sharp product and label, softly blurred background, generous negative space, sophisticated high-end fragrance advertising, realistic proportions. No people, no clutter, no watermarks.
